source_clause: LS1.1) The 4 types of adjustments the user will be able to alter for lumbar/bolster will be: Lumbar In/Out, Lumbar Up/Down, Back Bolster, Thigh Bolster.
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.2.1（LS1.1）所列腰靠／側靠四種可調類型皆可取得。關鍵情境條件：需先開啟 Seats tab —— 該動作為 step-controlled state，依 §4.4 下放為 procedure 第 1 步而非 Pre-Condition（20 §1 修正）。為什麼這樣切：037 對本節僅產出一個 leaf（parent 形態即需求，R-C3），且條文以單句列舉四者，拆成四條會使 Test Set 欄淪為 TC ID 副本。刻意略過：各類型之調整範圍與級距 —— 本節未定義，級距屬 13.5 且其量值由 CFTS044 擁有（19 §4.2）。

tcs.tc_title: Four lumbar and bolster adjustment types are available
tcs.test_item:
LS1.1) The 4 types of adjustments the user will be able to alter for lumbar/bolster will be: Lumbar In/Out, Lumbar Up/Down, Back Bolster, Thigh Bolster.

(The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls; read the list of lumbar and bolster adjustment types offered on the Seats tab)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Seats tab
2. Read the list of lumbar and bolster adjustment types offered on the Seats tab
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Seats tab is shown
2. The offered adjustment types are "Lumbar In/Out", "Lumbar Up/Down", "Back Bolster" and "Thigh Bolster"
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
